about: Assertions that fail on main (ca9db0a, v147) before anyone touches anything. run-checks.mjs marks a failure KNOWN when EVERY failing item of that check matches one of these patterns (a regex tested against the failing line's text); anything else is NEW. `flaky: true` = it fails on some runs only (usually a timing budget on a loaded box) — accepted when it fails, never reported FIXED? when it passes. Evidence: the baseline run of 2026-09-24 (full suite, 4 jobs, then every failure re-run twice at 3 jobs). Delete an entry when you fix it; see docs/CHECKS.md.

failures.pattern: ^worn or injured is -10% stats
failures.note: stale: v120 made fatigue a slope (fatigueMulV120) — worn now reads 0.85, not the flat 0.90 this asserts

failures.pattern: ^in between is neutral
failures.note: stale: v120's slope puts a mid-fatigue man at 0.967, not 1.0

failures.pattern: ^(live field is up|the wall mounts inside \.field-wrap|watched a run of plays|a badge was on screen during the run)
failures.note: its click-through (PLAN -> null) often never reaches the live field since the v146 D plan board; 3 of 4 tries failed, one passed

failures.pattern: ^(the crystal floats above the head|it turns — the silhouette changes|the live field is up|it draws over the players|a gassed player gets a different crystal)
failures.note: +5.5px above the sprite root / 0.55px width swing on the run that reached the field; the other runs never reached it (a crash in the probe)

failures.pattern: ^exit 1: page\.evaluate
failures.note: the probe throws when the live field never comes up

failures.note: reads -1.93 (NET NEGATIVE) on every run

failures.note: peak 0 — the roar never registered on 2 of 4 tries (timing)
